```diff
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ MCP 客户端示例 - 连接和使用 MCP 服务器
+ 
+ 这个示例展示如何使用 MCP (Model Context Protocol) 连接到服务器并调用工具
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+ import asyncio
+ import json
+ from typing import Optional
+ from contextlib import AsyncExitStack
+ 
+ # 需要安装: pip install mcp anthropic
+ try:
+     from mcp import ClientSession, StdioServerParameters
+     from mcp.client.stdio import stdio_client
+     from anthropic import Anthropic
+ except ImportError:
+     print(&quot;请先安装依赖: pip install mcp anthropic&quot;)
+     exit(1)
+ 
+ 
+ class MCPClientExample:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;MCP 客户端示例类&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     
+     def __init__(self):
+         self.sessions = []
+         self.exit_stack = AsyncExitStack()
+         
+     async def connect_to_server(self, server_script_path: str):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         连接到 MCP 服务器
+         
+         Args:
+             server_script_path: MCP 服务器脚本路径
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         server_params = StdioServerParameters(
+             command=&quot;python&quot;,
+             args=[server_script_path],
+             env=None
+         )
+         
+         stdio_transport = await self.exit_stack.enter_async_context(
+             stdio_client(server_params)
+         )
+         stdio, write = stdio_transport
+         session = await self.exit_stack.enter_async_context(
+             ClientSession(stdio, write)
+         )
+         
+         await session.initialize()
+         self.sessions.append(session)
+         return session
+     
+     async def list_tools(self, session: ClientSession):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;列出服务器提供的所有工具&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         response = await session.list_tools()
+         print(&quot;\n可用工具列表:&quot;)
+         print(&quot;=&quot; * 60)
+         for tool in response.tools:
+             print(f&quot;\n工具名称: {tool.name}&quot;)
+             print(f&quot;描述: {tool.description}&quot;)
+             if hasattr(tool, &#39;inputSchema&#39;):
+                 print(f&quot;输入参数: {json.dumps(tool.inputSchema, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)}&quot;)
+         print(&quot;=&quot; * 60)
+         return response.tools
+     
+     async def call_tool(self, session: ClientSession, tool_name: str, arguments: dict):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         调用 MCP 工具
+         
+         Args:
+             session: MCP 会话
+             tool_name: 工具名称
+             arguments: 工具参数
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         print(f&quot;\n调用工具: {tool_name}&quot;)
+         print(f&quot;参数: {json.dumps(arguments, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)}&quot;)
+         
+         result = await session.call_tool(tool_name, arguments)
+         print(f&quot;结果: {result}&quot;)
+         return result
+     
+     async def list_resources(self, session: ClientSession):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;列出服务器提供的所有资源&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         response = await session.list_resources()
+         print(&quot;\n可用资源列表:&quot;)
+         print(&quot;=&quot; * 60)
+         for resource in response.resources:
+             print(f&quot;\nURI: {resource.uri}&quot;)
+             print(f&quot;名称: {resource.name}&quot;)
+             print(f&quot;描述: {resource.description}&quot;)
+         print(&quot;=&quot; * 60)
+         return response.resources
+     
+     async def read_resource(self, session: ClientSession, uri: str):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;读取资源内容&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         print(f&quot;\n读取资源: {uri}&quot;)
+         result = await session.read_resource(uri)
+         print(f&quot;内容: {result}&quot;)
+         return result
+     
+     async def cleanup(self):
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;清理资源&quot;&quot;&quot;
+         await self.exit_stack.aclose()
+ 
+ 
+ async def example_filesystem_mcp():
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;示例1: 使用文件系统 MCP 服务&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     print(&quot;\n&quot; + &quot;=&quot; * 70)
+     print(&quot;示例 1: 文件系统 MCP 服务&quot;)
+     print(&quot;=&quot; * 70)

+         
+         # 调用工具 - 写入文件
+         await client.call_tool(session, &quot;write_file&quot;, {
+             &quot;path&quot;: &quot;test_output.txt&quot;,
+             &quot;content&quot;: &quot;这是通过 MCP 写入的内容！&quot;
+         })
+         
+     finally:
+         await client.cleanup()
+ 
+ 
+ async def example_database_mcp():
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;示例2: 使用数据库 MCP 服务&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     print(&quot;\n&quot; + &quot;=&quot; * 70)

+         })
+         
+         # 查询数据
+         await client.call_tool(session, &quot;execute_query&quot;, {

+     finally:

+ 
+ async def example_weather_mcp():

+     print(&quot;\n&quot; + &quot;=&quot; * 70)

+     print(&quot;=&quot; * 70)
+     
+     client = MCPClientExample()
+     
+     try:
+         # 连接到天气 MCP 服务器
+         session = await client.connect_to_server(&quot;mcp_server_weather.py&quot;)
+         
+         # 列出所有可用工具
+         tools = await client.list_tools(session)
+         
+         # 获取天气信息

+         
+         # 获取天气预报

+     finally:
+         await client.cleanup()
+ 
+ 
+ async def main():
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;主函数 - 运行所有示例&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     print(&quot;\n&quot; + &quot;=&quot; * 70)

+     # 运行各个示例（注释掉的示例需要对应的服务器文件）
```

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,221 @@
- 
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ MCP 服务器示例 - 文件系统操作
+ 
+ 这个 MCP 服务器提供文件系统相关的工具
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+ import os
+ import asyncio
+ from pathlib import Path
+ 
+ try:
+     from mcp.server import Server
+     from mcp.server.stdio import stdio_server
+     from mcp.types import Tool, TextContent
+ except ImportError:
+     print(&quot;请先安装依赖: pip install mcp&quot;)
+     exit(1)
+ 
+ 
+ # 创建 MCP 服务器实例
+ app = Server(&quot;filesystem-server&quot;)
+ 
+ 
+ @app.list_tools()
+ async def list_tools() -&gt; list[Tool]:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;列出所有可用的工具&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     return [
+         Tool(
+             name=&quot;read_file&quot;,
+             description=&quot;读取文件内容&quot;,
+             inputSchema={
+                 &quot;type&quot;: &quot;object&quot;,
+                 &quot;properties&quot;: {
+                     &quot;path&quot;: {
+                         &quot;type&quot;: &quot;string&quot;,
+                         &quot;description&quot;: &quot;要读取的文件路径&quot;
+                     }
+                 },
+                 &quot;required&quot;: [&quot;path&quot;]
+             }
+         ),
+         Tool(
+             name=&quot;write_file&quot;,
+             description=&quot;写入内容到文件&quot;,
+             inputSchema={
+                 &quot;type&quot;: &quot;object&quot;,
+                 &quot;properties&quot;: {
+                     &quot;path&quot;: {
+                         &quot;type&quot;: &quot;string&quot;,
+                         &quot;description&quot;: &quot;要写入的文件路径&quot;
+                     },
+                     &quot;content&quot;: {
+                         &quot;type&quot;: &quot;string&quot;,
+                         &quot;description&quot;: &quot;要写入的内容&quot;
+                     }
+                 },
+                 &quot;required&quot;: [&quot;path&quot;, &quot;content&quot;]
+             }
+         ),
+         Tool(
+             name=&quot;list_directory&quot;,
+             description=&quot;列出目录中的文件和文件夹&quot;,
+             inputSchema={
+                 &quot;type&quot;: &quot;object&quot;,
+                 &quot;properties&quot;: {
+                     &quot;path&quot;: {
+                         &quot;type&quot;: &quot;string&quot;,
+                         &quot;description&quot;: &quot;目录路径&quot;
+                     }
+                 },
+                 &quot;required&quot;: [&quot;path&quot;]
+             }
+         ),
+         Tool(
+             name=&quot;delete_file&quot;,
+             description=&quot;删除文件&quot;,
+             inputSchema={
+                 &quot;type&quot;: &quot;object&quot;,
+                 &quot;properties&quot;: {
+                     &quot;path&quot;: {
+                         &quot;type&quot;: &quot;string&quot;,
+                         &quot;description&quot;: &quot;要删除的文件路径&quot;
+                     }
+                 },
+                 &quot;required&quot;: [&quot;path&quot;]
+             }
+         ),
+         Tool(
+             name=&quot;file_info&quot;,
+             description=&quot;获取文件信息（大小、修改时间等）&quot;,
+             inputSchema={
+                 &quot;type&quot;: &quot;object&quot;,
+                 &quot;properties&quot;: {
+                     &quot;path&quot;: {
+                         &quot;type&quot;: &quot;string&quot;,
+                         &quot;description&quot;: &quot;文件路径&quot;
+                     }
+                 },
+                 &quot;required&quot;: [&quot;path&quot;]
+             }
+         )
+     ]
+ 
+ 
+ @app.call_tool()
+ async def call_tool(name: str, arguments: dict) -&gt; list[TextContent]:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;处理工具调用&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     
+     if name == &quot;read_file&quot;:
+         path = arguments[&quot;path&quot;]
+         try:
+             with open(path, &#39;r&#39;, encoding=&#39;utf-8&#39;) as f:
+                 content = f.read()
+             return [TextContent(
+                 type=&quot;text&quot;,
+                 text=f&quot;文件内容:\n{content}&quot;
+             )]
+         except FileNotFoundError:
+             return [TextContent(
+                 type=&quot;text&quot;,
+                 text=f&quot;错误: 文件 {path} 不存在&quot;
+             )]
+         except Exception as e:
+             return [TextContent(
+                 type=&quot;text&quot;,
+                 text=f&quot;错误: {str(e)}&quot;
+             )]
+     
+     elif name == &quot;write_file&quot;:
+         path = arguments[&quot;path&quot;]
+         content = arguments[&quot;content&quot;]
+         try:
+             with open(path, &#39;w&#39;, encoding=&#39;utf-8&#39;) as f:
+                 f.write(content)
+             return [TextContent(
+                 type=&quot;text&quot;,
+                 text=f&quot;成功写入文件: {path}&quot;
+             )]
+         except Exception as e:
+             return [TextContent(
+                 type=&quot;text&quot;,
+                 text=f&quot;错误: {str(e)}&quot;
+             )]
+     
+     elif name == &quot;list_directory&quot;:
+         path = arguments[&quot;path&quot;]
+         try:
+             items = os.listdir(path)
+             files = []
+             dirs = []
+             for item in items:
+                 full_path = os.path.join(path, item)
+                 if os.path.isfile(full_path):
+                     files.append(item)
+                 else:
+                     dirs.append(item)
+             
+             result = f&quot;目录 {path} 的内容:\n\n&quot;
+             result += f&quot;文件夹 ({len(dirs)}):\n&quot;
+             for d in dirs:
+                 result += f&quot;  📁 {d}\n&quot;
+             result += f&quot;\n文件 ({len(files)}):\n&quot;
+             for f in files:
+                 result += f&quot;  📄 {f}\n&quot;
+             
+             return [TextContent(type=&quot;text&quot;, text=result)]
+         except Exception as e:
+             return [TextContent(
+                 type=&quot;text&quot;,
+                 text=f&quot;错误: {str(e)}&quot;
+             )]
+     
+     elif name == &quot;delete_file&quot;:
+         path = arguments[&quot;path&quot;]
+         try:
+             os.remove(path)
+             return [TextContent(
+                 type=&quot;text&quot;,
+                 text=f&quot;成功删除文件: {path}&quot;
+             )]
+         except Exception as e:
+             return [TextContent(
+                 type=&quot;text&quot;,
+                 text=f&quot;错误: {str(e)}&quot;
+             )]
+     
+     elif name == &quot;file_info&quot;:
+         path = arguments[&quot;path&quot;]
+         try:
+             stat = os.stat(path)
+             info = f&quot;文件信息: {path}\n&quot;
+             info += f&quot;大小: {stat.st_size} 字节\n&quot;
+             info += f&quot;创建时间: {stat.st_ctime}\n&quot;
+             info += f&quot;修改时间: {stat.st_mtime}\n&quot;
+             info += f&quot;访问时间: {stat.st_atime}\n&quot;
+             return [TextContent(type=&quot;text&quot;, text=info)]
+         except Exception as e:
+             return [TextContent(
+                 type=&quot;text&quot;,
+                 text=f&quot;错误: {str(e)}&quot;
+             )]
+     
+     return [TextContent(
+         type=&quot;text&quot;,
+         text=f&quot;未知工具: {name}&quot;
+     )]
+ 
+ 
+ async def main():
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;启动 MCP 服务器&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     async with stdio_server() as (read_stream, write_stream):
+         await app.run(
+             read_stream,
+             write_stream,
+             app.create_initialization_options()
+         )
+ 
+ 
+ if __name__ == &quot;__main__&quot;:
+     asyncio.run(main())
+ 
```

```diff
+ 
+ @app.call_tool()
+ async def call_tool(name: str, arguments: dict) -&gt; list[TextContent]:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;处理工具调用&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     
+     if name == &quot;execute_query&quot;:
+         query = arguments[&quot;query&quot;]
+         params = arguments.get(&quot;params&quot;, [])
+         
+         try:
+             conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
+             cursor = conn.cursor()
+             
+             if params:
+                 cursor.execute(query, params)
+             else:
+                 cursor.execute(query)
+             
+             # 如果是 SELECT 查询，获取结果
+             if query.strip().upper().startswith(&quot;SELECT&quot;):
+                 rows = cursor.fetchall()
+                 columns = [desc[0] for desc in cursor.description]
+                 
+                 result = f&quot;查询结果 ({len(rows)} 行):\n\n&quot;
+                 result += &quot; | &quot;.join(columns) + &quot;\n&quot;
+                 result += &quot;-&quot; * 50 + &quot;\n&quot;
+                 for row in rows:
+                     result += &quot; | &quot;.join(str(val) for val in row) + &quot;\n&quot;
+             else:
+                 conn.commit()
+                 result = f&quot;查询执行成功，影响了 {cursor.rowcount} 行&quot;
+             
+             conn.close()
+             return [TextContent(type=&quot;text&quot;, text=result)]
+             
+         except Exception as e:
+             return [TextContent(type=&quot;text&quot;, text=f&quot;错误: {str(e)}&quot;)]
+     
+     elif name == &quot;list_tables&quot;:
+         try:
+             conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
+             cursor = conn.cursor()
+             cursor.execute(&quot;SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type=&#39;table&#39;&quot;)
+             tables = cursor.fetchall()
+             conn.close()
+             
+             result = &quot;数据库中的表:\n\n&quot;
+             for table in tables:
+                 result += f&quot;  📊 {table[0]}\n&quot;
+             
+             return [TextContent(type=&quot;text&quot;, text=result)]
+         except Exception as e:
+             return [TextContent(type=&quot;text&quot;, text=f&quot;错误: {str(e)}&quot;)]
+     
+     elif name == &quot;describe_table&quot;:
+         table_name = arguments[&quot;table_name&quot;]
+         try:
+             conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
+             cursor = conn.cursor()
+             cursor.execute(f&quot;PRAGMA table_info({table_name})&quot;)
+             columns = cursor.fetchall()
+             conn.close()
+             
+             result = f&quot;表 {table_name} 的结构:\n\n&quot;
+             result += &quot;列名 | 类型 | 非空 | 默认值 | 主键\n&quot;
+             result += &quot;-&quot; * 50 + &quot;\n&quot;
+             for col in columns:
+                 result += f&quot;{col[1]} | {col[2]} | {col[3]} | {col[4]} | {col[5]}\n&quot;
+             
+             return [TextContent(type=&quot;text&quot;, text=result)]
+         except Exception as e:
+             return [TextContent(type=&quot;text&quot;, text=f&quot;错误: {str(e)}&quot;)]
+     
+     return [TextContent(type=&quot;text&quot;, text=f&quot;未知工具: {name}&quot;)]
+ 
+ 
+ async def main():
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;启动 MCP 服务器&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     async with stdio_server() as (read_stream, write_stream):
+         await app.run(
+             read_stream,
+             write_stream,
+             app.create_initialization_options()
+         )
+ 
+ 
+ if __name__ == &quot;__main__&quot;:
+     asyncio.run(main())
+ 
```

</details>

```diff
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ MCP 服务器示例 - 天气 API 服务
+ 
+ 这个 MCP 服务器提供天气查询相关的工具（模拟数据）
+ &quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 
+ import asyncio
+ import random
+ from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+ 
+ try:
+     from mcp.server import Server
+     from mcp.server.stdio import stdio_server
+     from mcp.types import Tool, TextContent
+ except ImportError:
+     print(&quot;请先安装依赖: pip install mcp&quot;)
+     exit(1)
+ 
+ 
+ # 创建 MCP 服务器实例
+ app = Server(&quot;weather-server&quot;)
+ 
+ 
+ # 模拟天气数据
+ WEATHER_DATA = {
+     &quot;北京&quot;: {&quot;temp&quot;: 15, &quot;condition&quot;: &quot;晴朗&quot;, &quot;humidity&quot;: 45, &quot;wind&quot;: &quot;东北风 3级&quot;},
+     &quot;上海&quot;: {&quot;temp&quot;: 20, &quot;condition&quot;: &quot;多云&quot;, &quot;humidity&quot;: 65, &quot;wind&quot;: &quot;东南风 2级&quot;},
+     &quot;广州&quot;: {&quot;temp&quot;: 28, &quot;condition&quot;: &quot;阴天&quot;, &quot;humidity&quot;: 80, &quot;wind&quot;: &quot;南风 1级&quot;},
+     &quot;深圳&quot;: {&quot;temp&quot;: 27, &quot;condition&quot;: &quot;小雨&quot;, &quot;humidity&quot;: 85, &quot;wind&quot;: &quot;东南风 2级&quot;},
+     &quot;成都&quot;: {&quot;temp&quot;: 18, &quot;condition&quot;: &quot;多云&quot;, &quot;humidity&quot;: 70, &quot;wind&quot;: &quot;无持续风向&quot;},
+ }
+ 
+ 
+ @app.list_tools()
+ async def list_tools() -&gt; list[Tool]:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;列出所有可用的工具&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     return [
+         Tool(
+             name=&quot;get_weather&quot;,
+             description=&quot;获取指定城市的当前天气&quot;,
+             inputSchema={
+                 &quot;type&quot;: &quot;object&quot;,
+                 &quot;properties&quot;: {
+                     &quot;city&quot;: {
+                         &quot;type&quot;: &quot;string&quot;,
+                         &quot;description&quot;: &quot;城市名称&quot;
+                     }
+                 },
+                 &quot;required&quot;: [&quot;city&quot;]
+             }
+         ),
+         Tool(
+             name=&quot;get_forecast&quot;,
+             description=&quot;获取指定城市的天气预报&quot;,
+             inputSchema={
+                 &quot;type&quot;: &quot;object&quot;,
+                 &quot;properties&quot;: {
+                     &quot;city&quot;: {
+                         &quot;type&quot;: &quot;string&quot;,
+                         &quot;description&quot;: &quot;城市名称&quot;
+                     },
+                     &quot;days&quot;: {
+                         &quot;type&quot;: &quot;integer&quot;,
+                         &quot;description&quot;: &quot;预报天数（1-7天）&quot;,
+                         &quot;minimum&quot;: 1,
+                         &quot;maximum&quot;: 7
+                     }
+                 },
+                 &quot;required&quot;: [&quot;city&quot;, &quot;days&quot;]
+             }
+         ),
+         Tool(
+             name=&quot;list_cities&quot;,
+             description=&quot;列出所有支持的城市&quot;,
+             inputSchema={
+                 &quot;type&quot;: &quot;object&quot;,
+                 &quot;properties&quot;: {}
+             }
+         )
+     ]
+ 
+ 
+ @app.call_tool()
+ async def call_tool(name: str, arguments: dict) -&gt; list[TextContent]:
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;处理工具调用&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     
+     if name == &quot;get_weather&quot;:
+         city = arguments[&quot;city&quot;]
+         
+         if city not in WEATHER_DATA:
+             return [TextContent(
+                 type=&quot;text&quot;,
+                 text=f&quot;抱歉，暂不支持查询 {city} 的天气信息&quot;
+             )]
+         
+         weather = WEATHER_DATA[city]
+         result = f&quot;&quot;&quot;
+ 🌤️ {city} 当前天气:
+ 
+ 温度: {weather[&#39;temp&#39;]}°C
+ 天气: {weather[&#39;condition&#39;]}
+ 湿度: {weather[&#39;humidity&#39;]}%
+ 风向: {weather[&#39;wind&#39;]}
+ 
+ 更新时间: {datetime.now().strftime(&#39;%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S&#39;)}
+         &quot;&quot;&quot;
+         
+         return [TextContent(type=&quot;text&quot;, text=result.strip())]
+     
+     elif name == &quot;get_forecast&quot;:
+         city = arguments[&quot;city&quot;]
+         days = arguments[&quot;days&quot;]
+         
+         if city not in WEATHER_DATA:
+             return [TextContent(
+                 type=&quot;text&quot;,
+                 text=f&quot;抱歉，暂不支持查询 {city} 的天气信息&quot;
+             )]
+         
+         base_weather = WEATHER_DATA[city]
+         conditions = [&quot;晴朗&quot;, &quot;多云&quot;, &quot;阴天&quot;, &quot;小雨&quot;, &quot;晴转多云&quot;]
+         
+         result = f&quot;📅 {city} 未来 {days} 天天气预报:\n\n&quot;
+         
+         for i in range(days):
+             date = datetime.now() + timedelta(days=i)
+             temp = base_weather[&#39;temp&#39;] + random.randint(-3, 3)
+             condition = random.choice(conditions)
+             
+             result += f&quot;{date.strftime(&#39;%Y-%m-%d&#39;)} ({[&#39;今天&#39;, &#39;明天&#39;, &#39;后天&#39;][i] if i &lt; 3 else &#39;&#39;})\n&quot;
+             result += f&quot;  温度: {temp}°C\n&quot;
+             result += f&quot;  天气: {condition}\n\n&quot;
+         
+         return [TextContent(type=&quot;text&quot;, text=result.strip())]
+     
+     elif name == &quot;list_cities&quot;:
+         result = &quot;🏙️ 支持的城市列表:\n\n&quot;
+         for i, city in enumerate(WEATHER_DATA.keys(), 1):
+             result += f&quot;{i}. {city}\n&quot;
+         
+         return [TextContent(type=&quot;text&quot;, text=result)]
+     
+     return [TextContent(type=&quot;text&quot;, text=f&quot;未知工具: {name}&quot;)]
+ 
+ 
+ async def main():
+     &quot;&quot;&quot;启动 MCP 服务器&quot;&quot;&quot;
+     async with stdio_server() as (read_stream, write_stream):
+         await app.run(
+             read_stream,
+             write_stream,
+             app.create_initialization_options()
+         )
+ 
+ 
+ if __name__ == &quot;__main__&quot;:
+     asyncio.run(main())
+
```

```diff
+ # MCP (Model Context Protocol) 示例项目
+ 
+ 这个项目展示了如何使用 MCP 创建客户端和服务器。
+ 
+ ## 文件说明
+ 
+ - &#96;mcp_client_example.py&#96; - MCP 客户端示例，连接并调用各种 MCP 服务
+ - &#96;mcp_server_filesystem.py&#96; - 文件系统操作 MCP 服务器
+ - &#96;mcp_server_database.py&#96; - SQLite 数据库操作 MCP 服务器
+ - &#96;mcp_server_weather.py&#96; - 天气查询 MCP 服务器（模拟数据）
+ - &#96;example.txt&#96; - 用于测试文件读取的示例文件
+ 
+ ## 安装依赖
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ pip install -r requirements.txt
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 或者手动安装：
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ pip install mcp anthropic
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ ## 运行示例
+ 
+ ### 方式 1: 运行完整客户端示例
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ python mcp_client_example.py
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 这将依次运行所有三个示例（文件系统、数据库、天气）。
+ 
+ ### 方式 2: 单独启动服务器
+ 
+ 在一个终端启动服务器：
+ 
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;bash
+ # 启动文件系统服务器
+ python mcp_server_filesystem.py
+ 
+ # 或启动数据库服务器
+ python mcp_server_database.py
+ 
+ # 或启动天气服务器
+ python mcp_server_weather.py
+ &#96;&#96;&#96;
+ 
+ 然后在另一个终端运行客户端。
+ 
+ ## MCP 工具列表
+ 
+ ### 文件系统服务器
+ - &#96;read_file&#96; - 读取文件内容
+ - &#96;write_file&#96; - 写入文件
+ - &#96;list_directory&#96; - 列出目录内容
+ - &#96;delete_file&#96; - 删除文件
+ - &#96;file_info&#96; - 获取文件信息
+ 
+ ### 数据库服务器
+ - &#96;execute_query&#96; - 执行 SQL 查询
+ - &#96;list_tables&#96; - 列出所有表
+ - &#96;describe_table&#96; - 显示表结构
+ 
+ ### 天气服务器
+ - &#96;get_weather&#96; - 获取当前天气
+ - &#96;get_forecast&#96; - 获取天气预报
+ - &#96;list_cities&#96; - 列出支持的城市
+ 
+ ## 注意事项
+ 
+ 由于 MCP Python SDK 可能还在开发中，如果遇到导入错误，可以使用简化版本的示例。
+ 
+ ## 学习资源
+ 
+ - [MCP 官方文档](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/)
+ - [MCP GitHub](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol)
+ 
```
